bio: 20, creative, having fun. My Instagram bio still says 19; it's catching up. I study marketing at UBC Sauder and spend the rest of my time editing videos, designing things and picking up hobbies at an alarming rate.
Right now that means running content for UBC IMPRINT, UBC Kababayan and Young Ventures, a guitar I'm still negotiating with, and walls I mostly fall off.
